definition.title: MSE future-range replacement [report paragraph label]
definition.source_excerpt: R119: after appending the red→blue source, the future [2,4] range was removed and an independent green clip was appended at offset 2. The same SourceBuffer then showed red at 1.5 s and green at 2.5/3.5 s. This demonstrates bounded in-place future replacement without reconstructing the MediaSource.
definition.impact_basis: Potentially removes substantial work from an eligible playback, seek, preparation, retention or repeated interaction. Scope comes from the cited card; exposure and effect size are unmeasured.
definition.default_next_action: Trace the precise owner, generation, reset/flush/commit or allocation being changed. Reproduce the present behavior before removing any guard.

definition.scope_contract: Actual output identity and timeline, surviving consumers, committed generations and cleanup; candidate execution must be visible.
definition.negative_control: Cancel or replace a source at the changed boundary and delay a stale callback/consumer; reject late publication and premature reuse.
definition.stop_boundary: At the first need for a cross-backend ownership redesign, record DEFER_SETUP. Do not remove a semantically required reset or increase a timeout to hide a failure.
definition.shared_prerequisite: Relevant existing runtime/owner only. Do not require every other backend to pass before this independent screen.
definition.reopen_condition: A new applicable workload, resolved prerequisite, better independent oracle, or materially different bounded implementation changes the recorded decision.
definition.relevance_basis: Editorial fit to ordinary Demuxe playback goals, not measured prevalence; rerank after one local opportunity audit.

define.basis: Existing source-grounded definition imported; acceptance criteria must be reviewed before a new run.

prepare.basis: New executable probe and declared workload/controls registered with source/input/runtime evidence.

screen.basis: Valid same-configuration future replacement preserves all 96 complete B-frame pictures: the first source remains unchanged and the future interval becomes the requested second source on the same SourceBuffer. However, the actual failed-append control ends the MediaSource after destructive removal and loses the old future. The currently required rollback gate fails, so this is not a qualified replacement transaction.

correctness.basis: Two independent 48-frame AVC sources, 24 fps, composition lead 83.333 ms. Replace the future at the established RAP boundary while paused at 0.5 s. Every valid-path queried RGBA image matches the isolated source oracle and the same SourceBuffer remains. A real AAC-only initialization under the AVC lane produces CHUNK_DEMUXER_ERROR_APPEND_FAILED; the range falls from [0.083333,4.083332] to [0.083333,2.083332] and the MediaSource ends. Cleanup passes. Existing stale-generation controls remain separate; no audio or transactional rollback claim is inferred from the positive picture result.
